# malloc

Fixed-block pools of up to 128, 2048 and 16384 bytes; logs an error above 16 KB.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x60022782` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [ep7 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/ep7-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus PEN E-P7](../cameras/ep7.md)

Returns uncached addresses, so all cores see the same bytes. Class 1 (up to 2048) is 0xa1f8d800..0xa1f98540.
